replies.body: It's just too... flat and gray.

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
I think it looks pretty cool. I agree that there is a lot of gray but, it makes the place look so dead, which is a good thing. The name being Echo Valley, I envision as the echos of lost souls who have died in this gray place. The gameplay looks well but, I would prefer less of those mountains in the map. You may have my +1. 

*I thought you were map dev?
